C Set minecraft:overworld to 100 tick(s)
BRAIN V1 acts=core;idle
BRAIN V2 acts=core;idle
BRAIN V3 acts=core;idle
# a floor bell facing north is rung from the north or south face; the side faces, the top and a high hit do nothing
BE 0 -60 0 {components:{},id:"minecraft:bell",x:0,y:-60,z:0}
EV sound at=0.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
BE 0 -60 0 {components:{},id:"minecraft:bell",x:0,y:-60,z:0}
BRAIN V1 acts=core;idle
BRAIN V2 acts=core;idle
BRAIN V3 acts=core;idle
# a bell facing east is rung from the east face only (the facing axis)
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=0,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=3
EV sound at=8.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
# ceiling bell: any side face rings it
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=8,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=5
EV sound at=16.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
# wall bell facing north: rung from the east or west face
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=16,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=2
EV sound at=24.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=24,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=4
# redstone: a powered neighbour rings once, powered stays, then loses power
EV sound at=32.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
B 32 -60 0 minecraft:bell[attachment=floor,facing=north,powered=true]
B 33 -60 0 minecraft:redstone_block
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=32,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=2
B 32 -60 0 minecraft:bell[attachment=floor,facing=north,powered=false]
EV sound at=32.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
B 32 -60 0 minecraft:bell[attachment=floor,facing=north,powered=true]
B 33 -60 0 minecraft:redstone_block
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=32,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=2
BRAIN V1 acts=core;idle
BM V1 type=heard_bell_time value=38 ttl=inf
BRAIN V2 acts=core;idle
BM V2 type=heard_bell_time value=38 ttl=inf
BRAIN V3 acts=core;idle
# ringing again after the 60 tick search interval refreshes the nearby entity list
EV sound at=0.5,-59.5,0.5 r=32.0 ex=0 event=minecraft:block.bell.use source=block vol=2.0 pitch=1.0
EV block_event r=64.0 ex=0 pos=0,-60,0 block=minecraft:bell b0=1 b1=2
BRAIN V1 acts=core;idle
BM V1 type=heard_bell_time value=98 ttl=inf
BRAIN V2 acts=core;idle
BM V2 type=heard_bell_time value=98 ttl=inf
BRAIN V3 acts=core;idle
